modules.download.heading: Find more Bibles and tools
modules.download.online: Bible Nav goes online only when you ask. Checking reads the list of modules from github.com; downloading fetches the files you choose from there.
modules.download.caution: Anyone who can watch your connection may see that it was made. Where reading the Bible is risky, think about who that could be. Modules can also be copied in from another computer or a thumb drive.
modules.download.portable: On a portable copy, downloads are saved only to the modules folder on its own drive.
modules.download.then-check: Then checking its signature and text
modules.download.signed-note: Every module listed here is signed, and is checked again after downloading before it can be opened.

modules.change.question: What about the modules you have now?
modules.change.move: Move them to the new folder
modules.change.move-hint: Each module is checked in its new place before the old copy is removed. A module whose name is already there stays where it is, and you're told which.
modules.change.leave-hint: The new folder gets the built-in modules and anything already in it. Your current folder stays as it is, ready to copy or share.
